verdict.rationale: Copilot's privacy FAQ documents an opt-out, available at any time, from using your conversation activity for model training, and lets you delete individual conversations or your full history. That is a first-party control over how usage data is used, but it is not documented as a general telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Missing for 10: a documented opt-out of diagnostic/telemetry data collection, a usage-tracking or analytics opt-out, coverage of Copilot integrated in Microsoft 365 apps, and independent corroboration that the opt-out works.
